verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that Mastra builds MCP servers, has an MCP client (stdio only, per one community report), and lets you browse project templates. None of that is a searchable catalog or registry of MCP servers and tools organized by capability. Templates are adjacent, not this story, and an agent framework could plausibly ship registry discovery, so the axis applies and the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a developer, I can search and browse a large catalog of MCP servers and tools by capability before wiring anything into my agent
